notes: the two branches meet at «قالا جميعا حدثنا هشام بن سعد»: the names after it are the shared tail (rule 3)
«بمعنى حديث نافع عن ابن عمر» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, never a route (rule 4)
«عن أبيه» has no name in the text: a relation (rule 7); «عن النبي» is the Prophet, not a link (rule 12)
